verdict.rationale: Sentry's self-hosted option (sentry-docs-11,26,37,39) implies full control over data storage/retention/deletion since the user owns the infrastructure, and its API can 'manage and export data' (sentry-docs-14,20), but there is no explicit documentation in the pack of retention-period settings, PII scrubbing, or a deletion/right-to-be-forgotten workflow for the SaaS product. Missing for 10: explicit data-retention configuration docs, explicit deletion/erasure API or UI controls, GDPR/CCPA compliance documentation.
